description.desc_thousand_char: Paharpur 3P Private Limited (PPPL) is engaged in the manufacturing of flexible packaging materials. The company offers pouches, rollstocks, retort packaging, shrink sleeves, cold seal laminates, and paper bags and wraps, among others. PPPL caters to liquid packaging, foods, beverages, pet food, agri and agri-chemical, and healthcare, among others. PPPL is a subsidiary of Floeter India Retort Pouches Pvt Ltd. It is an ISO 9001, ISO 22000, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001 certified company. The company was incorporated in 2014 and has its registered office located in Kolkata, West Bengal.
